model: ADK digital air handler, DSTREAM controls (Daikin Applied Europe)
applies_to: Daikin Applied Europe ADK digital air handling units (D-AHU) with the MicroTech III or MicroTech 4 controller and DSTREAM control software.
summary: The ADK digital AHU uses a MicroTech III or MicroTech 4 controller; BACnet IP comes from a POL908 module and BACnet MS/TP from a POL904 module. The list covers air temperatures, humidity, pressures, flows and air quality (including Modbus room probes), damper, fan, coil and valve signals, comfort/economy/boost setpoints, fan and filter alarms, operating mode and source, summer/winter changeover, energy data and bit-coded alarm words for EC fans, valves and room probes. Object instances are fixed but non-sequential.
notes: Which objects exist depends on the AHU configuration (fans, coils, recovery, humidity, VOC/CO2 sensors, Sintra, Modbus fans/valves/room probes).

Positive integer value alarm words are bit-coded: guide table A covers EC fan words (e.g. bit 0 motor blocked, bit 1 phase loss, bit 15 communication error), table B Modbus valves and table C room probes.

AI 58004 is printed for both VOCSensor and AddVOCX8, and PIV 56094 for both SplyFan6AmWord2 and RtrnFan7AlmWord2; the second of each is listed without an instance. ByPassDmpFBDevAlm and MixingDmpFBDevAlm are each printed as the name of two different BIs.
GenAlm (BI 41868) and AlmOutHigh (BO 5714) give the same general alarm.
Fan setpoints with a summer/winter split use the base object for summer and the ...Wi objects for winter.
The cover reads D-EIGOC00108-22_05EN but the revision table only runs to _02EN (16/09/2025).

source.title: BAS integration guide - BACnet protocol (ADK (Digital AHU))

integration.summary: Write the operating command to NetworkCtrlBMS, set summer/winter with SuWiNetworkChgover after setting SuWiChgSrc to BMS, and write the comfort cooling/heating setpoints. Read the operating mode and status, supply and controlled temperatures and the general alarm; use the alarm words for fan and valve diagnostics.

minimum_points.name: SuWiChgSrc
minimum_points.why: Must be 3 = BMS for the summer/winter command

integration.enable: NetworkCtrlBMS (MV 26007, 1 = Auto, 2 = Off, 3 = On, 4 = Ventilation, 5 = Economy, 6 = Boost) is the BMS operating command; NetworkCtrl (MV 24562) is the on/off source used by a Daikin iTM. ActOpSta (MV 32321) reports 11 = BMS when the network is in control. Summer/winter changeover follows the BMS only when SuWiChgSrc (MV 9493) = 3 (BMS); then write SuWiNetworkChgover (MV 28594).
integration.heartbeat: No BMS heartbeat is described. Fan setpoints SplyFanSpvP2PCommAlm / RtrnFanSpvP2PCommAlm (AV 59879/18352) apply only when the controllers' peer-to-peer link fails.
setup: BACnet IP comes from a POL908 module and BACnet MS/TP from a POL904 module plugged onto the MicroTech controller.
BACnet IP defaults: device instance 1, UDP port 47808, DHCP off; set Apply Changes = Yes after editing, which restarts the controller.

BACnet MS/TP module defaults: MAC address 24, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1; the device instance is derived from the production number and date code. Cycle power after changing the address.
Object instances are fixed, non-sequential numbers (e.g. SupplyTmp = AI 45150); map by instance, not by position.
EDE files are regenerated each time the BACnet server starts and can be downloaded by FTP from the POL908; re-export them after any configuration change.
gotchas: Objects only appear when the AHU configuration uses them (fans, coils, recovery, humidity, air quality).
Engineering units of fan setpoints follow SplyEngUnit / ExhEngUnit (%, Pa or m3/h) and humidity units follow HumEngUnit.
Multistate commands are 1-based (1 = Off, 2 = On); 0 is not a valid state.
AckAlmPls (MV 39130) acknowledges every alarm in the controller at once.
CommTestEn (MV 1708) enables a test mode; leave it at 1 = No.
Damper signal AOs (64026, 59501, 50404, 40983, 11376, 50562) are marked writable; writing them can override the unit's own damper control.
